# Repository Validation Outcomes

## Acceptance Criteria

### A semantic workflow with valid members passes repository validation

Verifies:

- [Each spec bundle is discovered as a direct child of the spec root](workflow-contract.md#each-spec-bundle-is-discovered-as-a-direct-child-of-the-spec-root)
- [Every declared member remains inside its own spec bundle](bundle-containment-rules.md#every-declared-member-remains-inside-its-own-spec-bundle)
